items.title: One-Click Translation for Your Entire Menu
items.description: Select a target language, tap translate, and your entire menu — categories, dish names, descriptions — is translated instantly. The AI preserves culinary terms and adapts naturally for each language.

items.title: Edit and Fine-Tune Any Translation
items.description: Every AI translation is fully editable. Review the result, adjust any wording, and save. Your changes are preserved even if you re-translate other parts of the menu later.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about menu translation.

items.question: How accurate is the AI translation for food menus?
items.answer: Our AI is optimized for restaurant content. It understands that 'Beef Wellington' or 'Tiramisu' shouldn't be translated literally, and adapts descriptions to sound natural in each language.

items.question: Which languages are supported?
items.answer: 25+ languages including English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Russian, and many more European and Asian languages.

items.question: Can I translate just some items, not the whole menu?
items.answer: Yes. You can translate individual items, entire categories, or the whole menu at once. You have full control over what gets translated.

items.question: Does it cost extra per translation?
items.answer: AI translation is included in Basic and Pro plans with generous monthly limits. No per-word or per-item charges — translate as much as you need.
